rows.grounds: adverb indicating correct manner of worship
fused compound gandha-ādi in instrumental plural with abhi-pūjya

items.question: What is the proper mode of worshipping the prepared altar with sandalwood and other offerings?
premises: Altar is prepared with rice and pure water.
Worship uses sandalwood and related offerings.
items.inference: The altar must be worshipped properly with sandalwood and other offerings according to rule.
uncertainties: Exact list of gandha-ādi offerings is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: After preparing the altar, one should properly worship it with sandalwood and other offerings according to the prescribed rite.
